subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris on June 15th has been confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: June 15th, 10:00 AM Arrival: June 15th, 2:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
